def VTask.leastOfBdd {P : ℤ → Prop} [DecidablePred P] (b : ℤ) (Hb : ∀ z, P z → b ≤ z) (Hinh : ∃ z, P z) : { lb // P lb ∧ ∀ z, P z → lb ≤ z } := 
  let Q (k : Nat) := P (b + (k : ℤ))
  have hQex : ∃ k, Q k := by 
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Hinh 
    let k := (z - b).toNat 
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ z - b := (Hb z hz).le
    have h_eq : b + (k : ℤ) = z := by 
      rw [Int.coe_nat_toNat h_nonneg]
      ring
    use k 
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hz 
  let k_min := Nat.find hQex 
  let lb := b + (k_min : ℤ)
  have hP : P lb := by 
    rw [← Q k_min]
    exact Nat.find_spec hQex
  have hmin : ∀ z, P z → lb ≤ z := by 
    intro z hz 
    let k_z : Nat := (z - b).toNat 
    have h_nonneg_z : 0 ≤ z - b := (Hb z hz).le
    have h_eq_z : b + (k_z : ℤ) = z := by 
      rw [Int.coe_nat_toNat h_nonneg_z]
      ring
    have hQ_z : Q k_z := by 
      rw [h_eq_z]
      exact hz 
    have h_le_kz : k_min ≤ k_z := Nat.find_min' hQex hQ_z 
    calc lb = b + k_min := rfl
      _ ≤ b + k_z := by rwa [← Int.coe_nat_le, h_le_kz]
      _ = z := h_eq_z 
    exact this 
  ⟨lb, hP, hmin⟩
